people.role: Grey sister of the mine-road watch at the Gate Hermitage
people.appearance: Notched left ear, a shaft-fall scar; she knocks twice on any wall before leaning on it.
people.backstory: A miner's widow from Ngân Lũ Khoáng who took the grey robe after the shaft fall of 1158, she walks the mine road for Hướng Thiết Lan (huong_thiet_lan) and would follow the prioress Mạnh Tĩnh Chi (manh_tinh_chi) into any quarrel. She hoards the sisters' candle ends and blankets in a hole by the mine road, and Khâu Ngân Linh (khau_ngan_linh) slept the winter without one.

ties.note: the prioress who gave her the grey robe
her captain on the mine road
grey novice who sharpens the gate's swords

people.role: White nun who lays the hermitage's dead in the glacier, facing north
people.appearance: Two fingertips lost to frostbite on the left hand; she smells of cold lamp oil.
people.backstory: She lays the dead in the glacier facing Chúc Long Sơn. She has told the abbess she will walk to the seal in 1202 if Ứng Lê Âm (ung_le_am) is judged too young, and Mạnh Tĩnh Chi (manh_tinh_chi) has not forgiven her the offer. She draws pebbles for the glacier berths and keeps the black one in her sleeve; Khương Thạch Lựu's (khuong_thach_luu) father went to the common pit.

ties.note: offered to take the prioress's place on the walk of 1202
the keeper of the book of the dead

tree.intent: Ice, toward the cold that keeps the dead.

people.role: Cold Jade miner's daughter in the grey gate
people.appearance: Jade-green grit under every fingernail; her laugh arrives a breath late.
people.backstory: Her mother hauled jade out of Hàn Ngọc Khoáng beside Diệp Quang Nhi's (diep_quang_nhi) mother. She climbs toward the summit whenever she is let, hoping Ice will wake in her the way Light woke in her friend. She tells the sisters she has a cough and slips above the gate, and when a footprint turned up in the snow she let Diệp Quang Nhi (diep_quang_nhi) take the kneeling.

tree.intent: Metal, reaching toward Ice should it wake.

people.role: White novice who copies names into the book of the dead
people.appearance: Lips stained black from licking the brush; the new white robe is still stiff at the folds.
people.backstory: A Hòe Âm scribe's daughter, she was taught her letters before Ice woke in her on the glacier in 1196 and she was given the white robe that night. Giản Tố Y (gian_to_y) set her to copying the book of the dead, and she has begun adding the Silver Thread miners by name, which the book never did.

people.role: Tiêu-clan daughter in the grey gate; carries letters to the Tầm Kiếm lodge
people.appearance: Clan-green ribbon sewn inside her sleeve where the grey cannot show it.
people.backstory: Sent up from Hòe Âm in 1199 after her cousin Tiêu Ngọc Hòe (tieu_ngoc_hoe), she carries letters down the mine road to Tiêu Hòe Sinh (tieu_hoe_sinh) at the Tầm Kiếm lodge. The prioress opens the bag at the gate before she leaves with it, and Tiêu Ngọc Khê thinks that is the rule.

ties.note: the clan's son at Tầm Kiếm

people.role: Grey novice who sharpens the gate's swords
people.appearance: Whetstone sparks have nicked her forearms white; one front tooth is chipped on a sword hilt.
people.backstory: Her father was lost in a shaft of Hàn Kim Quật and his name is in the book of the dead. She wants a sword more than a robe, and spars with Khâu Ngân Linh (khau_ngan_linh) at the gate every dawn. When Khâu Ngân Linh's (khau_ngan_linh) hand caught in the grindstone she finished the blade before she let go of the wheel.

people.role: Herb nun who goes down to the miners with Úc Hàn Chân
people.appearance: Bright chilblains on both ears; the satchel rattles with glass phials.
people.backstory: A herb-dealer's daughter from the valley market, she goes on the mine visits with Úc Hàn Chân (uc_han_chan), and she has learned to set a crushed hand. She would rather stay below with the miners than ring the bell, and has said so aloud once.

tree.intent: Ice, and the herbs that grow in it.
